meta.system: Dấu Việt Global — Phase 04.1 Icon Optical & Context QA

16px.culture: use simplified single interlock/wave mark; canonical woven double-wave starts at 20px
16px.source: remove secondary text-line detail; retain document silhouette only
16px.story: simplify to single open-book contour; avoid inner spine micro-detail if rasterized
16px.journey: use two nodes + single path; enlarge nodes optically
16px.people: slightly enlarge head/body separation; 2px compact stroke
16px.event: reduce ray length / keep four cardinal ticks only
16px.time: slightly shorten hand detail; 2px compact stroke

micro_corrections.20px: canonical semantics allowed; compact stroke 2px acceptable
micro_corrections.24px: canonical master glyph size; preferred semantic/domain size
micro_corrections.32px: canonical geometry; no extra decorative detail should be introduced

context_qa.light_dark: PASS — currentColor construction survives light/dark; retain Phase 02 contrast tokens
context_qa.monochrome: PASS — all required meanings remain shape-based
context_qa.map_density: PASS_WITH_RULES — map uses 20–24px inner semantic glyphs; 16px reserved for utility-only dense states, not primary category recognition
context_qa.story_explorer: PASS — Story, Source, Evidence/Verified remain distinct at 20–24px
context_qa.journey: PASS_WITH_RULES — Journey canonical mark should not be used below 20px without micro simplification
context_qa.trust: PASS — Verified and Warning remain legible at 16px; disclosure text still required where semantics are non-obvious
context_qa.touch_target: PASS SPEC — visual glyph size is independent from 44×44 minimum interactive target

decision.16px: not all semantic master glyphs may use canonical detail; use defined micro variants
decision.32px: canonical display/feature size; do not add decorative detail
decision.production_lock: Phase 04 may proceed to Production Lock if micro variants are treated as part of the system
